gaps: Final block5 fallback covers only D1 Ultra-W manual physical p13 / printed11: both five-row battery SOC LED matrices and the adapter mains-input/indicator label. Eleven conditional rows added; no battery identity, operating tutorial or performance rating inferred. Other Ultra-W manual sections remain open.

G2 Appendix II remains inaccessible as an attachment: public manual text exposes the filename G02 Offline Data Collection Format Specification - rb235-EN.pdf without a clickable attachment reference in the web-tool result; two exact official-domain searches found no document and direct page fetch returned HTTP500. No schema or file URL was guessed, and no access block was bypassed.

G2 Appendix I complete 19-port service table and Appendix III radio declarations are now mapped: four Wi-Fi/Bluetooth EIRP entries, 14 LTE bands, 13 NR bands, three cellular-power rows and the antenna restriction. Port identifiers/regulatory values are not unconditional ratings; SIM activation is not inferred. Appendix II linked data-format document and other untouched sections remain open.

Parent-authorized wrapper corrections now cover exact G2 screen, Ultra-W whole-body DoF, Max payload, MaxPro energy/wading and same-model no-load speed source rows. Only exclusions/conditions changed; original data values and source evidence remain immutable. Different hardware ports and continuous-walking speed were not treated as conflicts.

D1 Max manual physical p11 complete 26-row table and p14 ports are mapped; MaxPro physical pp7-8 complete 33-row tables, pp9-15 electrical interfaces and pp22-23 battery details are mapped. Existing equivalent parameters are reused, not duplicated. This does not establish full manual or company completeness.

Remaining D1 work: cached Max/MaxPro other hardware accessory manuals and bounded remaining sections; Pro/Edu downloads timed out; Ultra/Ultra-W other chapters remain incomplete, including Ultra-W Turbo footnote clarification. Other AGIBOT model/component sources and prior conflicts remain open.

MaxPro communication-port scopes and connector electrical differences remain separately documented, not conflated across hardware ports. Full manufacturer/manual completeness is not claimed. Parent owns global validation and cache integration.
